application: hot-rolled steel strip surface inspection (NEU-DET classes)
coordinate_system: x runs across the strip width (left to right), y runs along the rolling direction (top to bottom); both normalised 0-1; zones A1..C3 on a 3x3 grid

crazing.meaning: network of fine surface cracks that can spread under forming

inclusion.meaning: foreign material embedded in the surface layer

rolled-in_scale.meaning: oxide scale pressed into the surface during rolling

pitted_surface.meaning: small local pits where surface material is lost

scratches.meaning: linear mechanical marks, usually cosmetic unless deep or long

patches.meaning: irregular discoloured or uneven areas, mostly cosmetic
